title: A/P Detail: column headings are in Title Case on screen, PDF and CSV
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in this report on today's date at two locations, so the Location column shows.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every group expanded (Expand all).
custom_steps:
1. Read the column headings, letter for letter, capitals included.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the PDF and read its column headings.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  5. Open the CSV in a plain text editor and read its column heading row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Date", "Location", "Transaction Type", "No.", "Vendor Name", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Amount", "Open Balance" (the chevron button sits before "Date"): every word starts with a capital letter.

Step 2:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 3:

  • The PDF's column headings read exactly as on screen, capitals included.

Step 4:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 5:

  • The heading row (right after the "As of: " and "Locations: All locations" rows) holds the same headings, letter for letter as on screen, and an "Aging Bucket" column for the bucket name ("Vendor Name" is already among the headings).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S2-R4a: “Column headings are in Title Case on all six reports, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV, as on the other reports (Sales By Customer, Inventory Value, Parts Velocity): the A/R reports read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due" and "Open Balance", the same as the A/P reports.”
  • S2-R1, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices columns: “A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount, Open Balance.”
  • S3-R8b: “The CSV column headings are the on-screen headings, letter for letter (S2-R4a): "Customer Full Name" on A/R Detail, "Customer" on A/R Collection, "Vendor Name" on the A/P reports. The bucket column on A/R Detail and A/P Detail is headed "Aging Bucket", and its values are the bucket names shown on screen.”
